status: version 4 approved by the owner on 2026-10-06 (versions 1 to 3 the same day). The game reads this file.
about: Every field a thing may carry, and the only values that field may take. A field that does not apply to a thing is left out of that thing; it is never written as 'not applicable'. The wording is what a child sees or hears; it is not data.
rules: A field holds the everyday meaning, which is what the game sorts by.
An _academic field is added only where science disagrees with the everyday meaning. It never sorts a board and never marks a child wrong.
A new field enters this file only after the owner has approved its values, and the version number then goes up by one.
A thing that truly fits more than one value of a field lists them all, and stays off boards sorted by that field.
The value 'depends' is only for things experts debate. It needs a note saying why, and such a thing also stays off boards sorted by that field.

An _academic field marked `only_where_science_differs` is carried only by the things for which a scientist's answer differs from the everyday one. It is absent everywhere else, and it never sorts a board.
